details.name: Determining When at Least One of the Three Boolean Variables is True
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether at least one of the three boolean variables is true based on the inputs that it receives from the user.

details.name: Determining When at Least One of the Three Boolean Variables is False
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether at least one of the three boolean variables is false based on the inputs that it receives from the user.

details.name: Determining When All Three Boolean Variables Are Equal
details.description: Construct a program that receives the value of three boolean variables from the user and determines whether all variables have the same value — either all three true or all three false.
